name: Galaxy USDT Quality
oneLiner: Galaxy USDT Quality is a Galaxy-curated Morpho V2 USDT lending vault; shares accrue interest, absorb losses, and redeem subject to liquidity.
collateral: USDT-denominated lender positions in Galaxy-curated Morpho markets. At the October 15, 2026 pin, allocation percentages (rounded to three decimal places) were 92.670% to WBTC-collateral markets, 5.449% cbBTC, 1.879% XAUt and 0.001% wstETH, with no idle USDT. These are lender-claim allocation weights, not ownership shares in borrower collateral or Tether reserves.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposits exchange USDT for NAV-bearing shares. Borrower interest and configured fee-share accrual change assets per share; realized lending losses can reduce NAV. Withdraw/redeem burns shares for idle USDT and liquidity from the configured adapter's selected wstETH/USDT market, not every funded market. Morpho's documented in-kind fallback uses a flash loan and leaves the holder with a direct underlying lending position; it does not guarantee cash realization or a settlement deadline when markets are illiquid. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum 0x71ffb6a81786ec285d429d531cf655107b9d878d issues proportional NAV-bearing lending-position shares over USDT, rather than a direct claim on Tether reserves. At Ethereum block 26197374 (2026-10-15T10:39:59Z), asset()=0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7, decimals()=18, totalSupply()=10478891992770618122577723 and totalAssets()=10659854285013 atomic USDT. The sole adapter 0x0b4bcdd43778df87befb011a27debf5e48a78b71 enumerates four markets whose expectedSupplyAssets sum to totalAssets; idle USDT is zero. Each local position has zero borrow shares and posted collateral. All four share/asset gates remain zero with irreversibly abdicated setters. Functional VaultV2 correspondence was reproduced against Sourcify compiler output, masking only declared immutables and CBOR; normalized runtime SHA-256 is cf17ab0161388ea9277000e692e929216da2618e441c54bcd677def1000dd12e. This proves operational accounting, not financial assurance, legal segregation, insolvency priority or full metadata/creation-bytecode identity.
